LanguageData.Gun_Fort-12_RWP.label: Fort-12
LanguageData.Gun_Fort-12_RWP.description: The Fort-12 is a compact semi-automatic pistol, favored for its reliability and ease of use. It fires standard rimfire rounds, making it an accessible sidearm for both novice and experienced shooters. With decent accuracy and a modest damage output, it's well-suited for self-defense in close quarters. Ideal for colonists who need a straightforward and effective firearm in potentially hostile environments.
